name: OpenEasyX
description: Open EasyX is one private, self-hosted application for discovering, downloading, organizing, browsing, and playing videos and images. It includes download queues, isolated partial downloads, library indexing, favorites, history, watch progress, live-cam playback, local subtitle transcription and translation, browser-assisted plugin login, and a built-in plugin store.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Stores databases, sessions, plugin repository checkouts, thumbnails, subtitles, logs, and downloaded AI models. Back up and protect this path.

paths.name: Media
paths.description: Stores the completed media library and private .downloads staging directory used for active transfers.

paths.name: External Plugins
paths.description: Optional legacy directory containing trusted external plugin folders. The built-in plugin store and added Git repositories are stored under Data instead.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Open EasyX web interface and API port. Keep this accessible only on a trusted LAN or through an authenticated reverse proxy. Container port: 3210.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: Host user ID used for files written to Data and Media. Unraid's nobody user is UID 99.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Host group ID used for files written to Data and Media. Unraid's users group is GID 100.

variables.name: Scan Interval
variables.description: Minutes between automatic media-library scans. The minimum effective value is 1 minute.

variables.name: Whisper Model
variables.description: Whisper model used for local subtitle transcription. Larger models require more memory, storage, and processing time.

variables.name: Translation Model
variables.description: Hugging Face model used for local subtitle translation.

variables.name: Subtitle Chunk Seconds
variables.description: Subtitle processing chunk length in seconds. Open EasyX constrains this value between 120 and 1800.

variables.name: Log Level
variables.description: Application log level, for example fatal, error, warn, info, debug, trace, or silent.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Timezone used by the container, for example America/Toronto.
